mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC <0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC <0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
